rule_title: Scope expansion is virtuous (one coherent thematic improvement)
message: Round delivers a coherent expansion of the report renderer (HTML output format, severity scoring rubric, CLI auto-format inference, paired tests). ~514 added lines in stepback/report.py + 216 lines in tests/test_report.py + CLI wiring. Single theme, no unrelated bundling — compliant.
Feature additions in stepback/report.py are accompanied by 216 net new lines in tests/test_report.py covering the new HTML renderer and severity rubric. Compliant.
No sacred files touched; the diff is confined to stepback/cli.py, stepback/report.py, tests, and orchestrator state directories.
evidence: git diff --stat shows no changes under kitchensink/

rule_title: Agent CLI is the reasoner; OPENAI_API_KEY restricted to images.generate/edit + Whisper
message: The new severity_score function is a deterministic numeric rubric (cost_delta, dirty_fraction, decision_flips, subtree_depth with fixed weights summed to a 0–100 band) — this is the 'numeric metrics / code wins' category from the use-the-agent-liberally runbook, not a reasoning task that needs the agent CLI. No direct OpenAI calls introduced. HTML rendering uses html.escape (stdlib). Compliant.

rule_title: Hygiene — committed build artifacts inflate the diff
message: 20 *.pyc files under stepback/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/ are tracked and updated each commit (e.g. report.cpython-311.pyc 37546→66135). They should be in .gitignore; checking them in obscures real diffs and risks stale-bytecode bugs across Python versions. Not a CONSTITUTION numbered rule, but worth fixing next round.

rule_title: Rule 3a — end-to-end fixture testing is mandatory
message: tests/test_report.py exercises the full render_report / render_html_report / severity_score path against the existing recorded-trace fixture (tests/fixtures/agent.run_recorded_agent), which is the repo's real end-goal artifact. No mocks introduced for the new HTML/severity surface. Round satisfies 3a via the existing 12-step agent fixture.
evidence: tests/test_report.py imports run_recorded_agent and asserts on rendered HTML / severity bands
